chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him): He expresses detachment from oppression.
The condition of Aqil regarding poverty and hunger.

key_terms.عَقِيل: Aqil, the brother of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali's statement about Aqil's poverty signify regarding detachment from oppression?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha, compiled by Sharif al-Radi, highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) spiritual and political disengagement from the ruling elite by invoking the memory of his brother Aqil’s enduring poverty. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that true leadership involves bearing the weight of injustice while maintaining inner purity, contrasting the material deprivation of the Ahl al-Bayt with the worldly power of the oppressors. The reference to Aqil serves as a poignant reminder of the familial sacrifice and the 'poverty of the righteous' that characterizes the Imams' detachment from temporal authority.
